description: Alongside my search for a permanent position, I am building a collaborative SaaS platform for engineering firms. It centralizes a project's technical files and brings together real-time whiteboard and mind map, request tracking and messaging.

B2B SaaS platform, repositioned mid-mission from an employee engagement product to a Sales Tech offering. Feature-first architecture in a Turborepo monorepo (React/TypeScript, NestJS), design of the internal design system (~150 components built on Ant Design, documented in Storybook), full frontend rebuild and development of an internal admin portal. Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations, i18n across 9 languages via Lokalise, state management with Zustand / TanStack Query.

Three years on varied frontend projects in production, from landing pages to business applications. Worked directly with clients to scope functional requirements, communicating mostly in English with international clients and teams.
